negative_findings.why_it_matters: These seed names may be stale, mis-transliterated, or refer to companies that were renamed, liquidated, or lost their web presence after 2022. They should be resolved via EDRPOU name search in Opendatabot/YouControl rather than by web search.

negative_findings.description: Several integrator/service sites (Ban Com Service, UMICON) display partner/client logo walls as images with no alt text or names, and no dedicated /clients or /partners URL.

negative_findings.description: 'Printec' resolves to three unrelated Ukrainian web presences: Printec Ukraine LLC (EDRPOU 35442628, the multinational transactional-tech group), printec.com.ua (business-automation hardware), and printec.ua (trade equipment/fasteners retailer).

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity resolution by brand name alone will produce false attributions in this cell. EDRPOU codes must be the join key, not company names.

negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-specific partner directory was located on the global vendor sites (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Hyosung TNS, GRG Banking) within this pass.

brief: Ukraine's banking-equipment channel is a Ukrainian-language-only layer: English search returns global vendor noise and essentially zero local actors, while uk queries surface a dense population of integrators (Servus Systems Integration, SystemGroup, Incom, IT-Integrator, BMS), multi-vendor field-service firms (PUSK, Ban Com Service, UMICON), single-brand cash-equipment distributors (Cassida UA, Deep2000, UHL-Mash) and a security/CIT tier (Venbest, CIT Security, Comservice) alongside Oschadbank as the largest outsourced ATM-servicing provider. The richest signal sits in vendor-partner and client logo walls on these companies' own homepages — which are almost always unlabelled images without dedicated /clients pages, so collection must combine HTML snapshots with logo capture/OCR. Because partner claims are one-directional self-assertions and brand names collide across unrelated entities, EDRPOU-keyed entity resolution via Opendatabot/YouControl plus Prozorro award records should serve as the hard-evidence backbone, with the EMA association partner directory and distributor partner-locator pages as the main snowballing routes. Biggest open risks: post-2022 status of these firms is unchecked and regional field-service subcontractors remain unenumerated.
